# v1.3.4 (todo.md item 20, W4a): fallback list of check-run names `release_gate.py`'s
# `check_required_checks_green()` requires to be green for a tag, used ONLY when the live
# GitHub branch-protection API call fails (network hiccup, permissions) — the live
# `required_status_checks` list on `master` is the primary source of truth and should be
# kept in sync with this file (`development/infrastructure.md`'s CI Job Map documents the
# same set; `tests/test_ci_map.py` checks the workflows agree with THAT doc — this file is
# the release-gate's own copy, checked in so the gate has a real answer even if `gh api`
# is briefly unreachable).
#
# Deliberately EXCLUDES: anything that only runs on a schedule (nightly.yml's jobs,
# `compat-drill`, `dr-drill`) — those never produce a check-run for a specific commit via
# an automatic trigger, so requiring them would make every release gate fail forever.
# Also excludes `flaky-quarantine` (continue-on-error by design) and `docker-edge.yml`'s
# path-filtered job (may legitimately not have run for a commit that touched none of its
# paths). One context name per line; blank lines and #-comments ignored.
